statement.source_mapping: /spec/source.txt: exactProductTree maps each pair to its exact real product; roundedProductTree maps each pair to Model.mul; roundedDotProduct applies roundedSum to that rounded product tree. The final theorem quantifies over every supplied Model and every binary Tree of real pairs, assuming only ((tree.depth + 1 : Nat) : Real) * model.u < 1, and states existence of a shape-preserving leafwise IsPerturbation of exactProductTree with bound gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u whose exactSum equals roundedDotProduct. All five supporting modules were copied unchanged from /spec/support/Research. Statement revision record: no /spec/feedback.json was present; no existing target statement was supplied in Submission.lean. This is the initial statement and matches the authoritative source; only its theorem proof is left as temporary sorry scaffolding for the next role.

verification.limitation: Compilation alone does not establish the original theorem or algorithm. Semantic review is required.

requirements.requirement: Prove the full universally quantified dot-product backward-error theorem.
requirements.evidence: The explicit target universally quantifies M and T and, under (depth(T)+1)*u<1, asserts existence of P satisfying both IsPerturbation(gamma(depth(T)+1,u),exactProductTree(T),P) and exactSum(P)=roundedDotProduct(M,T).

requirements.requirement: Relate perturbations to exact componentwise products x_i*y_i.
requirements.evidence: exactProductTree maps each original leaf pair (a,b) to the exact real product ab. The target perturbation relation preserves shape and bounds every corresponding leaf by |y-ab|<=gamma(k,u)|ab|.

requirements.requirement: Account for one rounded multiplication per leaf.
requirements.evidence: roundedProductTree maps each leaf (a,b) to r(ab), and roundedDotProduct reduces that tree. The target bounds perturbations relative to exact ab with k=depth(T)+1, including the multiplication rounding.

requirements.requirement: Account for every rounded tree addition in the reduction.
requirements.evidence: roundedSum at every internal node returns r(roundedSum(M,L)+roundedSum(M,R)). The target equality concerns roundedDotProduct, defined using this reduction of the rounded products in the original grouping.

requirements.requirement: Establish the gamma(depth+1,u) componentwise perturbation bound.
requirements.evidence: The target sets k=depth(T)+1 and asserts IsPerturbation(gamma(k,u),exactProductTree(T),P), where gamma(k,u)=ku/(1-ku). The leaf clause is |y-ab|<=gamma(k,u)|ab|, also enforcing zero perturbed leaves for zero exact products.

requirements.requirement: Use only the stated model and smallness assumptions without assuming or restricting the conclusion.
requirements.evidence: M has u>=0 and for every real z a delta with |delta|<=u and r(z)=z(1+delta). The sole additional theorem hypothesis is (depth(T)+1)*u<1. T is any finite binary tree of arbitrary real pairs, without balance, sign, nonzero, or exact-arithmetic restrictions. No conclusion is assumed.
